name: Spicy Sausage, Kale, Fennel & Sweet Potato Hash with Fried Egg

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg sweet potatoes
3 fennel bulbs
1 ½ bunches kale

instructions.primary_message: Peel and medium dice sweet potatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Trim off root end and stalks of the fennel, leaving only the white bulbs. Halve fennel bulbs lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the sweet potato.
Peel, halve, and slice onions crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground pork sausage

instructions.primary_message: Using a slotted spoon, remove sausage to a plate; set aside. (Reserve pot with drippings for the next step.)
Return pot (with drippings) to medium-high heat. Add veggies, salt, and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden-brown and tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces.

When the veggies are done, add vinegar and cooked sausage to the pot; stir to combine. Add kale to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the leaves to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Gently crack eggs into the skillet and cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 eggs
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide hash between plates or bowls. Top with fried eggs and enjoy!
